のインスタグラム：「Daily meal prep before heading out to @ctpconcepts. Plus breakfast. Supper is prepped fresh when I get home. Chicken breasts are marinated overnight in ziplock w the seasoning in the last picture along with juice of one lemon and a small bit of olive oil. Best way to track macros for me is to do it myself. Every day.  Meal plan is from @christinedwallace  What you don’t see is green veggies. They are on the plan, but when I am out all day I will generally skip them as this is a quicker prep. Also not seen is my serving of almonds.  Getting dialed in to hopefully start taping Straight Up Steve Austin. Like many others we have been on a delay.  Have a great day.」
